facts_claimed: Mallikarjun Jyotirlinga is located on the Shail mountain in Andhra Pradesh on the banks of the Krishna River.
The temple is mentioned in the Mahabharata, Shiv Puran, and Padma Puran.
Special rituals are performed from Tuesday to Friday in the week before Shravan.
The legend involves a competition between Ganesha and Kartikeya to circle the Earth.
Ganesha won by circling his parents, Shiva and Parvati.
The temple is named 'Mallikarjun' because it was first worshipped with Mallika (jasmine) flowers.
